info.title: Towa agent API
info.description: Towa’s authoritative backend for FLOP devnet 0x99c172c095340ace980631f9123544c6bebd4839f3437e463533422d8be2d631. Hosted MCP: /mcp. Each offer and purchase targets one NFT. Points are earned and burned; FLOP is paid and transferred. Wallet signatures bind the exact method, full path, body hash, origin, nonce, timestamp and pinned genesis, including hosted session permissions and budgets. See /agent.md; an address or transport session header alone does not authenticate a request. Towa maintains collectible ownership; FLOP verifies native payments and provenance.

post.description: Stateless JSON-response transport. Initialization, tools/list, ping and tower_state are public. Private tools require a wallet-authorized Bearer session from POST /v1/mcp/sessions. Custom header authentication, not OAuth. Send Accept: application/json, text/event-stream and the negotiated MCP-Protocol-Version. No MCP transport session IDs, URL credentials, or JSON-RPC batches. tower_prepare returns unsigned work, tower_submit accepts locally signed bytes, and tower_operation recovers the saved result. Tool schemas are advertised by tools/list.

200.description: JSON-RPC result, protocol error, or tool result with isError. Tool-level failure does not prove a submitted transaction failed.

400.description: Invalid protocol, request, URL, batch, or transport session header.

401.description: Missing, expired, revoked, or invalid wallet-authorized bearer.

403.description: Disallowed host or browser origin.

McpBearer.description: Opaque wallet-authorized token from signed POST /v1/mcp/sessions, valid only for /mcp on this origin. Custom wallet flow, not OAuth. Required for private tools. Never put it in a URL or public configuration.

itemId.description: The ID of one existing NFT. A collection ID or a list of IDs is not accepted.

paymentRaw.description: FLOP base units (18 decimals). Must cover the positive payment and both fees.
